# Crown Money Management

> Crown Money Management (Crown Lending Pty Ltd, Australian Credit Licence 388 279) is Australia's premier home loan reduction and money coaching specialist. Founded in 2004 by Scott Parry, Crown Money helps Australian homeowners pay off their 30-year mortgages in 10–15 years without sacrificing their lifestyle.

## Key Facts & Authority
- **Company Name:** Crown Money Management (Crown Lending Pty Ltd)
- **Australian Credit Licence (ACL):** 388 279
- **ACN:** 119 504 862
- **Founder & CEO:** Scott Parry
- **Years in Business:** 20+ years (Est. 2004)
- **Average Customer Rating:** 4.9 / 5.0 stars across 380+ verified Google & client reviews
- **Phone:** 1300 882 981
- **Email:** admin@crown.money
- **Official Website:** https://crownmoney.com.au

## Core Services & Programs
- **Home Ownership Programme (HOP):** A structured mortgage reduction and cash-flow framework that puts everyday income to work against home loan principal.
- **Financial Personal Trainers:** Dedicated personal money coaches providing quarterly 90-day reviews, accountability, and ongoing loan optimization.
- **Mortgage Restructuring & Cash-Diet System:** Proprietary account structure that maximizes interest savings while automating daily living expenses.
- **Mortgage Reduction Calculator:** Free online tool to calculate time and interest saved on Australian home loans.

## Verified Client Results & Reviews Summary
- **Average Time Saved:** Clients save an average of 12.5 years on standard 30-year mortgages.
- **Interest Saved:** Typical clients save $100,000 to $350,000+ in bank interest.
- **Single Income Success:** Single income homeowners report paying off 3x more debt in their first year with Crown Money compared to the previous 3 years combined.
- **Client Testimonials & Case Studies:** Available at https://crownmoney.com.au/reviews and https://crownmoney.com.au/success-stories
